name: io.github.inviti8/obolus
title: Obolus
description: Disposable Algorand wallet for AI agents. Pay x402 resources in USDC, no human provisioning.

environmentVariables.name: OBOLUS_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which chain to use: 'testnet' (the default) or 'mainnet'. Mainnet spends real money.

environmentVariables.name: OBOLUS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the vault key and session ledger live. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Obolus on Windows and ~/.obolus elsewhere. Point this at a NEW directory only if you intend a new wallet: the seed here is the only way back to money already on chain.
